text: In March the whole system was due end of Q2. Phase 2 is now Q1 2027. What moved it, and what does the delay cost per month?
Vendor resourcing was the reason in May. Is it still the constraint, and is it the same vendor behind the Corvus slip in August?
No revised budget has appeared since March. Does the phase split change the total?
Turnover was 44% in May and 46% in August, and the August report says the recruiting pipeline is strong. What changes between now and year end to get under 40%?
Gross margin is 27.9% against 26.1% in March. How much of that is the pricing rollout, and is it in the year-end plan?
The CFO starts September 15. What does the first ninety days cover, and who owns the warehouse throughput read in September?
Hangar 3 was due in Q3, then October, then December. August cites vendor resourcing. Which vendor, and what is the plan if December moves?
The two territory reps were recruiting in March and have not appeared in a report since. Are they hired, on hold, or dropped?
Top customer is 33% of revenue, down from 38% in January. What gets it under 30%, and by when?
